title: Defect Codes and Complaint Descriptions
summary: This topic is dominated by negative service-record fragments listing defect codes and brief complaint descriptions, with examples spanning software faults, audio issues, a loose speaker mount, and one overheating and smoking complaint.

negative.summary: Negative fragments mainly consist of defect-code entries and short defect descriptions tied to software or equipment faults, audio-system concerns, a loose speaker mount, and a radiator leak with smoking and overheating.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe QR-code scanning and BMW ID login steps, but they do not provide enough context to judge satisfaction or failure severity.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are terse service-record fields containing only defect codes or labels, which limits interpretation of the underlying customer experience.
The cluster mixes coded defect entries with QR-code and BMW ID workflow notes, so the topic is not fully coherent as a single issue.
Examples are insufficient to determine how often any specific defect code or complaint type occurs beyond this sample.
